protocol_note: Supplementary fixed 60s evaluation, all complete nonoverlapping segments from each record start; full-record results retained; not a model improvement or verified paper protocol

fixed_duration.aggregation: arithmetic mean of segment RMSEs within each record, then equal-weight mean over eligible records
fixed_duration.selection: all complete non-overlapping segments starting at record time zero; incomplete tails excluded; no error-based selection
fixed_duration.alignment: initial translation at every segment start only; no rotation or scale fitting
fixed_duration.rte_protocol: 30-second endpoint differences within each segment; pairs crossing segment boundaries excluded
